# AmountInput

Figma: [03c. AmountInput](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-898) · Family: 03 Form & Input · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-05-21

A display-first input for Saudi Riyal monetary values. The amount is the hero - large bold integer, smaller muted decimals, Riyal symbol as a subtle prefix. Used wherever investors enter or see investment amounts: deal cards, investment calculator, top-up flow, profit displays, KYC income fields.

### Input Amount Value

The SAR amount display atom: Riyal symbol, a large bold integer and small muted decimals, so the figure reads first.

Level: atom · Part of: Input Amount, Amount Stepper

Use when:
- Inside Input Amount and Amount Stepper
- Custom amount fields that must match the Safqah amount typography

Don't use when:
- Read-only balances and returns outside a field: use MoneyAmount
- Plain text values: use Input Value

Accessibility: Read the amount and currency as one phrase (for example «1,000 ريال») rather than the symbol glyph alone.

### Input Amount

A labelled, taller bordered field for typing a free-form SAR amount, with the amount as the hero and a helper for limits. Used for investment amount, top-up, withdrawal and income fields.

Level: organism · Contains: Input Label, Input Amount Value, Input Helper Text

Use when:
- Entering the investment amount on a deal page: Size=lg, helper «الحد الأدنى للاستثمار 1,000 ر.س»
- Withdrawal or wallet top-up amounts
- Showing a locked amount during confirmation: State=disabled

Don't use when:
- Amounts that change in fixed steps (for example 1,000 SAR units): use Amount Stepper
- Approximate values along a range: use Slider Field
- Small integer counts: use NumericStepper
- Non-money text: use Input

Accessibility: On validation failure keep the typed amount visible with a specific error in the helper, never reset to 0.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

### Amount Stepper

A bordered SAR amount with minus and plus buttons on either side, for amounts that move in fixed steps. With Show Actions=false it becomes a read-only amount box.

Level: organism · Contains: Input Amount Value

Use when:
- Adjusting an investment in fixed units (each step 1,000 SAR)
- Recurring contribution levels or tiered amounts
- Read-only amount summaries that match stepper rhythm: Show Actions=false

Don't use when:
- Free-form amounts the user types: use Input Amount
- Plain integer counts without currency: use NumericStepper

Accessibility: Give the minus and plus chunks accessible names and disable them at the min and max rather than ignoring taps.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

Input Amount differs from a regular Input by treating the value as the hero rather than supporting chrome. The amount integer is rendered larger and bolder than regular input text, with decimals reduced and muted (visually superscript-like) so the eye lands on the meaningful figure first.

Used across Safqah for monetary entry and display: investment amount on deal cards, KYC income range, transfer amount in top-up flows, distribution amounts on portfolio screens. Always Saudi Riyal (﷼) - Safqah is a Saudi-only platform.

### At a glance

| Default · placeholder | Focus · entered amount | Error · validation failed |
| --- | --- | --- |

### Atomic architecture

Input Amount follows the same atomic pattern as Input and Input Phone. Two new components live on this page; the rest are reused from Input.

Atom (new) - Input Amount Value

12 variants. The visual core: Saudi Riyal symbol (﷼) + bold amount integer + smaller muted decimals. Exposes Amount and Decimals TEXT props for value overrides.

Atoms (reused) - Input Label, Input Helper Text

Same atoms used by Input organism. 6 + 2 variants. Consistent label/helper treatment across all input families.

Organism - Input Amount

30 variants. Composes Label + bordered Field (with Input Amount Value inside) + Helper. Same bordered field treatment as standard Input. Field is taller (64/56/48 vs 48/40/32) to accommodate the prominent amount.

### Anatomy

The Amount Value atom has three rendered pieces: the Riyal symbol, the amount integer (the visual hero), and the decimals (a quiet suffix). The organism wraps that atom in a standard bordered Field with Label above and optional Helper below.

| Label Standard Input Label atom. "Investment amount" or Arabic "مبلغ الاستثمار". Same as Input. | Riyal symbol (﷼) Unicode U+FDFC (Arabic Ligature Rial Sign). Rendered with Noto Sans Arabic for glyph coverage. Color: text/muted in placeholder state, text/default when value is entered. | Amount integer The hero. font/weight/semibold, 24dp (lg) / 20dp (md) / 16dp (sm). text/default when value is entered, text/muted in placeholder. | Decimals Subtle suffix. 14dp (lg) / 12dp (md) / 11dp (sm), top-aligned for superscript treatment. Always text/muted regardless of state. | Bordered Field Same field treatment as Input - bg/surface, 1dp border, Radius/8. Taller than standard Input (64/56/48 vs 48/40/32) to accommodate the larger amount text. | Helper text Optional. Shows currency range, minimum investment, or error message. Same Input Helper Text atom. |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Sizes

Three sizes match the prominence the amount should carry on the screen. lg for primary entry moments (investment input, top-up amount), md for inline forms (KYC income, recurring contribution), sm for compact contexts (table cells, summary rows).

Large (64dp field, amount 24dp)

Primary entry moments. The investment amount on a deal page. The transfer amount in a top-up flow. The hero numeric input on a screen.

Medium (56dp field, amount 20dp)

Inline forms. KYC income range. Recurring contribution amount. Secondary numeric inputs in longer forms.

Small (48dp field, amount 16dp)

Compact contexts. Table cells with editable amounts. Summary rows. Use sparingly - amount loses some prominence at this size.

### States

Five states match the rest of the Input family. The placeholder state shows "0" rather than abstract text - it reads as a real zero amount, which matches what banks and brokerages do.

default

Empty input ready for entry. Shows "0.00" in muted color. The Riyal symbol is also muted to match.

active

User has entered a value. The amount becomes the dark hero color (text/default), border firms up slightly (border/strong).

focus

User is currently typing. 2dp focus ring (border/focus). Best paired with the on-screen keyboard for numeric input.

error

Validation failed - amount out of range, below minimum, or non-numeric. Red border + helper text. Keep the entered value visible.

disabled

Field locked. Used during async submission, after success, or when amount is fixed by context (e.g. paying off a specific reservation).

### Direction - LTR and RTL

In LTR, the Riyal symbol sits on the leading edge (left), then the amount. In RTL, the symbol moves to the trailing edge (right), amount on the left. The amount digits themselves stay LTR even inside an RTL context - Arabic numerals always read left-to-right.

LTR

Default. Symbol on left ( ﷼ 1,000.00 ). Amount reads naturally. Use in English contexts or when the surrounding UI is LTR.

RTL

Arabic context. Symbol on right ( 1,000.00 ﷼ ). Matches how Saudi users see currency amounts in Mada/STC Pay/Sabb apps and Arabic-language financial materials.

### Amount Stepper - quantity control with +/− buttons

Amount Stepper is a sibling parent component to Input Amount - same atom (Input Amount Value), different chrome. Where Input Amount is a typed-input form field, Amount Stepper is a quantity adjuster with explicit +/− buttons flanking the amount. Use it when the amount is incremented in fixed steps rather than freely typed.

Common on Safqah: investment slot quantity in a deal cart (each slot is 1,000 SAR - tap + to add another), recurring contribution amount adjustment, fee tier selection, anywhere the user picks from discrete amounts rather than entering a free-form number.

### Anatomy

| Decrement chunk (−) Leading side button. Minus icon (1.5dp stroke) bound to icon/default. Right-side separator stroke (border/default) at 1dp inner edge. In RTL this chunk moves to the trailing side. | Amount area Center area containing an Input Amount Value atom instance. Exposed as a nested instance so Amount/Decimals/Symbol props bubble up to the parent props panel. Fills remaining horizontal space. | Increment chunk (+) Trailing side button. Plus icon (1.5dp stroke). Left-side separator stroke at 1dp inner edge. In RTL this chunk moves to the leading side. | Show Actions boolean Toggles both increment and decrement chunks together. When false, the component becomes a bordered amount display - useful for read-only summaries that should still match the Stepper visual rhythm. |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Show Actions boolean - visual comparison

Show Actions = true (default)

Full stepper with +/− chunks. Tappable affordances for adjusting the amount in steps.

Show Actions = false

Bordered amount display only. Same visual frame as the stepper, no adjustment buttons. Read-only contexts.

### When to use Amount Stepper vs Input Amount

> **Info:** Pick Amount Stepper when the amount is incremented in fixed steps and the user benefits from tap-to-adjust (investment slot quantities, recurring contribution levels, deal share counts). Pick Input Amount when the user types a free-form numeric value (deposit amount, withdrawal request, transfer amount). Both share the same Input Amount Value atom - switching between them changes the interaction model without disturbing the amount's visual treatment.

### Code examples

Flutter implementations for common Safqah amount-entry scenarios.

### Investment amount on a deal page

```dart
// Primary investment input - biggest, most prominent
SafqahInputAmount(
  label: 'Investment amount',
  size: SafqahAmountSize.lg,
  initialValue: minimumInvestment,
  helperText: 'Minimum: SAR 1,000',
  onChanged: (sar) => _validateAmount(sar),
)
```

### KYC income range

```dart
// Secondary input in a longer form
SafqahInputAmount(
  label: 'Annual income',
  size: SafqahAmountSize.md,
  helperText: 'Used to determine investor tier eligibility',
  onChanged: (sar) => _kycForm.income = sar,
)
```

### Arabic RTL context

```dart
// Arabic deal page
Directionality(
  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
  child: SafqahInputAmount(
    label: 'مبلغ الاستثمار',
    size: SafqahAmountSize.lg,
    helperText: 'الحد الأدنى: 1,000 ريال',
    onChanged: _validateAmount,
  ),
)
```

### Validation error

```dart
// Below minimum or above cap
SafqahInputAmount(
  label: 'Investment amount',
  size: SafqahAmountSize.lg,
  state: SafqahAmountState.error,
  initialValue: enteredAmount, // keep what user typed
  helperText: 'Amount must be between SAR 1,000 and SAR 250,000 for your tier',
  onChanged: _validateAmount,
)
```

### Locked amount (after confirmation)

```dart
// Amount is fixed by context - user reviewing before final submit
SafqahInputAmount(
  label: 'Confirming investment',
  size: SafqahAmountSize.lg,
  state: SafqahAmountState.disabled,
  initialValue: confirmedAmount,
  helperText: 'Tap Edit to change',
)
```

### Usage - Do and Don't

Four Safqah scenarios paired with their wrong counterparts.

- **Do** · Primary investment entry: Use lg size for the moment-of-truth amount on a deal page. Amount is hero - large, bold, immediately readable. Investor knows what they're committing.
- **Don't** · Primary investment entry: Don't use sm for the primary investment amount. The number disappears into the form chrome, investors lose track of the figure they're entering. Tap targets are also marginal at sm.
- **Do** · Validation error feedback: Error state keeps the entered amount visible alongside the red border + helper text. Investor sees what they typed and can decide whether to adjust by a digit or reconsider entirely.
- **Don't** · Validation error feedback: Don't silently reset the field to "0" on validation failure. The entered value is destroyed, the investor doesn't know what was wrong, has to start over without context.
- **Do** · Arabic context: RTL: Riyal symbol on the right, amount on the left. Matches how Arabic users see currency in Mada, STC Pay, Sabb. Numbers themselves stay LTR - Arabic numerals always read left to right.
- **Don't** · Arabic context: Don't use LTR in Arabic flows. Symbol on the wrong side breaks scan patterns - users used to "1,000 ﷼" suddenly see "﷼ 1,000" and momentarily second-guess what currency they're reading.
- **Do** · Locked amount mid-flow: Disabled state with the amount still visible. Used when amount is fixed by context - confirming an investment, paying off a reservation. Gray fill signals "not editable here".
- **Don't** · Locked amount mid-flow: Don't leave the field editable when the amount is contextually fixed. Investors may try to change it, get confused why submit doesn't reflect their new value, contact support.

### Notes from the maintainer

Implementation decisions, trade-offs, and watch-outs.

> **Warning:** The Riyal symbol (﷼ U+FDFC) uses Noto Sans Arabic, not IBM Plex Sans. The IBM Plex Sans family does not include this glyph - it renders as tofu/missing. Noto Sans Arabic has it. This is a per-text-node font override on the currency-symbol text only; the rest of the atom uses IBM Plex Sans as usual.

> **Info:** The new Saudi Riyal symbol (U+20C0, a 2023 standard) is not yet widely supported in fonts. Stuck with the older Arabic Ligature Rial Sign (U+FDFC) until font coverage catches up. When Noto Sans Arabic and other major fonts add U+20C0 glyphs, swap the character and consider whether IBM Plex Sans Arabic can take over.

> **Info:** Input Amount is a SIBLING organism to Input, Input Underline, Input Phone - not a variant. Each has its own Field treatment and value atom. The atomic architecture means they all share the Label and Helper atoms. To switch from one input style to another, swap the entire organism instance.

> **Info:** Field height is larger than standard Input (64/56/48 vs 48/40/32). The bigger height accommodates the prominent 24/20/16dp amount integer plus visual breathing room. Don't shrink this - the amount loses its hero status if you try to fit it into a standard Input field height.

> **Tip:** Default Helper text is "Minimum investment: SAR 1,000" - Safqah-specific. Override per use case (e.g. "Maximum: SAR 250,000" for tier limits, "Daily limit: SAR 50,000" for top-up).

> **Info:** The Amount Value atom's "value" state has a default of "1,000" - that's what shows in the variant reference. At runtime, override Amount prop with the actual formatted value. Decimals prop defaults to ".00" - override only if you need different precision (e.g. ".50" or ".25").

> **Info:** Amount integer font sizes are RAW px (24/20/16), not bound to a font/size token. No matching tokens in the DS yet. Same flag as OTPInput's digit sizes - add tokens later, re-bind.

> **Warning:** FONT WARNING - Same as the rest of the input family: text uses IBM Plex Sans (non-Arabic) since Font/Family/Base resolves to IBM Plex Sans Arabic which isn't installed. The currency symbol IS using Noto Sans Arabic (specifically for the Riyal glyph). When IBM Plex Sans Arabic is installed, re-bind the integer/decimals text nodes; the symbol may stay on Noto for glyph reliability.
